'''Edward Stoddard Echo Base (the weirdest ever)''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Edward Stoddard]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19756">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19756 Echo Base (the weirdest ever)], DeckTech (edward "pimpwizard69" stoddard, 17 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19756/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19756/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016231554/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19756/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
